bounds_scope: diagnostic fixed caps, not validated physical constraints
full_text_dependency: prior-art comparison open; computational study authorized to continue without declaring novelty
inference: descriptive conditional experiments; no pooled independence, outcome-selected thresholds or p-value screening
knowledge_state: Historical arrays and Step1-3 findings known; these random realizations are newly generated after this lock; local specification, not external preregistration

clustered_holdout.spatial_regime: fixed 200-m easting gap between calibration and evaluation rectangles

noise_process: independent zero-mean Gaussian link noise for each calibration/query record; same standardized draws reused across matched/mismatched noisy conditions

query_support_challenge.purpose: fixed diagnostic signal mismatch relative to calibration; not claimed measured fading distribution

retention: save every arm error vector; reference weights, removal predictions and generated synthetic observations; compact per-field summaries and checks. Shared-arm errors may be stored explicitly. Per-arm centroids regenerate from saved inputs, fits and registry; not all intermediates retained.
seed_key: SeedSequence([20261007,4,layout_index,seed,stream]); streams 10 calibration positions,20 evaluation positions,30 calibration normal noise,40 evaluation normal noise,50 receiver-wise angles,60 shared coherent angle
selection: all six always selected; no reception censoring or RSSI clipping; this is a controlled signal model, not a radio-network simulator
shared_update: median of all fitted-minus-reference receiver updates, added to every original intercept
symmetry_cancellation: Retained explicitly in completed C1; random C2 fields need not satisfy symmetry. No outcome-selected cancellation filter.
